supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41 UTC, WS-DREYES-01 made a successful proxy GET request for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/copperline-it/tools/main/u.ps1; the proxy recorded status 200.

The script request occurred shortly after the reported PowerShell window, making it relevant to the alert, but the available records do not establish that the downloaded script was executed or caused the window to appear.
The records show a successful proxy tunnel to raw.githubusercontent.com at the same time as the script request, with a related HTTP connection through the proxy.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show network/proxy activity but do not include process-creation, PowerShell command-line, or PowerShell script-block telemetry for WS-DREYES-01.
The supplied records do not include the contents or hash of u.ps1, so its behavior and integrity cannot be assessed.
claims_not_established: Whether u.ps1 was downloaded to the workstation, executed, or merely requested.
Whether the PowerShell window reported by the user was associated with the request for u.ps1.
Whether the script was authorized, benign, or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process-creation and PowerShell operational/script-block logs for WS-DREYES-01 around 13:40–13:42 UTC, including parent process and command line.
The downloaded u.ps1 artifact, if present, including its hash and contents; compare it with the repository version and establish whether it was changed or removed.
User confirmation of what prompted the PowerShell window and whether they accessed or ran the script.
Repository ownership and change/approval records for copperline-it/tools and u.ps1.
unrelated_findings: At 13:30:40 UTC, WS-SALI-01 exchanged an ICMP connection with WS-DREYES-01; this is outside the reported PowerShell-window timing and does not establish a connection to the alerted activity (T103-00074).
